body:
Thanks for the reproducer, indeed it looks like a bug. 

The check was introduced because you cannot declare multiple emitters with different configurations.
The [overflow management](https://quarkus.io/blog/reactive-messaging-emitter/#overflow-management) section just gives a couple examples of overflow configurations.

issue.title: Fix Reactive Messaging Extension multiple different Emitter injections check
Kafka fails with multiple emitters(Emitter & MultinyEmitter) on the same channel

labels.name: triage/wontfix
labels.description: This will not be worked on

issue.body:
### Describe the bug

Using kafka reactive messaging, when creating 2 emitters (Emitter & MultinyEmitter) on one channel, the Quarkus app fails to start and throws the following exception:


```
@Inject
@Channel("words-out")
Emitter<String> emitter;

@Inject 
@Channel("words-out")
MutinyEmitter<String> mutinyEmitter;
```
```
2024-04-02 11:43:43,741 ERROR [io.qua.dep.dev.IsolatedDevModeMain] (Aesh InputStream Reader) Failed to start quarkus: java.lang.RuntimeException: io.quarkus.builder.BuildException: Build failure: Build failed due to errors
        [error]: Build step io.quarkus.smallrye.reactivemessaging.deployment.SmallRyeReactiveMessagingProcessor#build threw an exception: jakarta.enterprise.inject.spi.DeploymentException: Emitter configuration for channel `words-out` is different than previous configuration : QuarkusEmitterConfiguration{name='words-out', emitterType=io.quarkus.smallrye.reactivemessaging.runtime.EmitterFactoryForLiteral@78573ac8, overflowBufferStrategy=BUFFER, overflowBufferSize=-1, broadcast=false, numberOfSubscriberBeforeConnecting=-1}
        at io.quarkus.smallrye.reactivemessaging.deployment.SmallRyeReactiveMessagingProcessor.build(SmallRyeReactiveMessagingProcessor.java:308)
        at java.base/jdk.internal.reflect.NativeMethodAccessorImpl.invoke0(Native Method)
        at java.base/jdk.internal.reflect.NativeMethodAccessorImpl.invoke(NativeMethodAccessorImpl.java:77)
        at java.base/jdk.internal.reflect.DelegatingMethodAccessorImpl.invoke(DelegatingMethodAccessorImpl.java:43)
        at java.base/java.lang.reflect.Method.invoke(Method.java:568)
        at io.quarkus.deployment.ExtensionLoader$3.execute(ExtensionLoader.java:849)
        at io.quarkus.builder.BuildContext.run(BuildContext.java:256)
        at org.jboss.threads.ContextHandler$1.runWith(ContextHandler.java:18)
        at org.jboss.threads.EnhancedQueueExecutor$Task.run(EnhancedQueueExecutor.java:2513)
        at org.jboss.threads.EnhancedQueueExecutor$ThreadBody.run(EnhancedQueueExecutor.java:1538)
        at java.base/java.lang.Thread.run(Thread.java:833)
        at org.jboss.threads.JBossThread.run(JBossThread.java:501)
```

### Expected behavior

Two emitters for the same channel should not cause any problem. 

### Actual behavior

_No response_

### How to Reproduce?

I've create a reproducer here: https://github.com/kennylam91/quarkus-multiple-kafka-emitters-issue-reproducer


### Output of `uname -a` or `ver`

_No response_

### Output of `java -version`

openjdk 17.0.7

### Quarkus version or git rev

3.8.3

### Build tool (ie. output of `mvnw --version` or `gradlew --version`)

Maven 3.8.3

### Additional information

The multiple emitter configuration worked well with 3.2.
I encounted this issue when upgrading Quarkus from 3.2 to 3.8.
